$comment: The disposables of NCode.Disposables, for the picker on /start/which-disposable/ (WhichDisposable.astro, DisposableCard.astro) and the matrix on /reference/behavior/ (BehaviorMatrix.astro): one data file, so the two cannot disagree. `anchor` is the card's anchor on /start/which-disposable/; `snippet` the key of the call its card shows. Booleans in `behavior`: true, false, or null where the question does not apply. Text fields take `code` and [links](/x/).

questions.text: What should happen when the scope ends?

answers.text: My own code runs
Resources I hold are disposed
A lock is released, or work is cancelled
Nothing, or only a record that it ended
An `IDisposable` is disposed by code that only takes an `IAsyncDisposable`

questions.text: How often may your code run?

answers.text: Once, however often the scope is disposed
On every `Dispose` call
On every call, in a hot path that must not allocate

questions.text: Which resources, and who owns them?

answers.text: Several, disposed together, the last one added first
One I keep in a field and replace over time
One that several owners share
One I build in steps and hand on only if every step succeeds
One that must be disposed on a UI thread or another `SynchronizationContext`

questions.text: What happens to the old one when you replace it?

answers.text: I keep it, or dispose it myself
It is disposed
There is no old one: the resource arrives once, maybe after the scope began
Release a `SemaphoreSlim` or a `ReaderWriterLockSlim`
Cancel a `CancellationToken`
Nothing: a method must return a disposable anyway
Record that the scope ended, to read later

outcomes.name: `Disposable.Create`
outcomes.use: Run a cleanup action when a scope ends, such as unsubscribing a handler.
outcomes.watchFor: The action runs on the first `Dispose` only. Up to eight arguments pass state to a `static` lambda.

behavior.holds: An `Action`, or a `Func` whose result it discards
behavior.onDispose: Runs the action on the first call; later calls do nothing

outcomes.name: `Disposable.CreateRepeatable`
outcomes.use: Run an action on every `Dispose` call, such as counting how often a scope ends.
outcomes.watchFor: Every call runs the action again, so the action must be safe to repeat.

behavior.onDispose: Runs the action on every call

outcomes.name: `Disposable.CreateValue`
outcomes.use: Run a static action with a state value in a hot path, without allocating.
outcomes.watchFor: It is a struct: every dispose of every copy runs the action, and `default` does nothing. Dispose it once, through `using`.

behavior.onDispose: Runs the action on every dispose of every copy

outcomes.name: `Disposable.Collection`
outcomes.use: Dispose several resources together, the last one added first.
outcomes.watchFor: Every item is disposed even when one throws: one failure is rethrown, several as one `AggregateException`. `CollectionIgnoringExceptions` ignores them.

behavior.holds: Any number of resources, in the order you add them
behavior.onDispose: Disposes every item in reverse order, on the first call

outcomes.name: `Disposable.Aggregate`
outcomes.use: Hold one resource in a field and swap it, keeping the old one alive.
outcomes.watchFor: Replacing the resource does not dispose the old one: that is yours to do.

outcomes.name: `Disposable.Serial`
outcomes.use: Hold one resource in a field and dispose the old one each time you replace it, such as a subscription you renew.
outcomes.watchFor: The async form replaces through `SetDisposableAsync`, which awaits the old one's disposal.

outcomes.name: `Disposable.SingleAssignment`
outcomes.use: Create the holder first and give it its one resource later, such as a connection that is still opening.
outcomes.watchFor: A second assignment throws `InvalidOperationException`, also after disposal.

behavior.onDispose: Disposes the resource, if one was assigned

outcomes.name: `Disposable.Guard`
outcomes.use: Build a resource in steps and hand it to the caller only when every step succeeds.
outcomes.watchFor: Return `guard.Release()`, not `guard.Value`: the guard disposes a value it still owns.

behavior.holds: One resource, until `Release()` hands it on
behavior.onDispose: Disposes the resource unless it was released
